metadata.aspect_ratio_rules: 16:9 with 2.35:1 letterbox baked in; titles in middle band safe zone
overlays: Title cards top of frame list, never inside depth axis; CRT scanlines + tracking bar as global texture overlays
VHS OSD 'PLAY' + timestamp early beats; 'NO SIGNAL' glitch into s4
metadata.support_insert_rules: No stock, no AI gen: all inserts are programmatic (fluorescent grids, corridor, key wall, red door, room with chairs, tag). Grain + chromatic split unify them.
metadata.title_card_rules: Monospace, all caps, letter-spaced; max 6 words per card; hold 2.5-3s; red reserved for THE HOMES KEEP THEIR PEOPLE.
transition_rules: fade to black into s4 reveal and out of s6
VHS dropout burst at 00:30 (signal loss into reveal)

scenes.description: Opening hero: infinite fluorescent office grid at night, slow push-in. Title: AN AVERAGE DAY AT CIELO.
scenes.information_role: Viewer learns the place: too clean, too empty, humming.

required_assets.description: fluorescent grid frames + drone bed + narration s1

scenes.shot_intent: Hook: sell normal, let the emptiness do the dread.

scenes.description: Morning routine board: coffee, keys, handshakes as pictogram row; one smile glyph repeats. Title: EVERY SMILE. HELD TOO LONG.
scenes.framing: centered triptych with repeating smile motif
scenes.information_role: Routine is perfect; repetition is the tell.
scenes.movement: subtle lateral drift + blink glitch on smiles

required_assets.description: routine pictogram frames + pulse layer + narration s2

scenes.shot_intent: Escalation: the average day is too average.

scenes.description: Endless corridor with looping doors, perspective crawl. Title: 9:00 AM / AGAIN.
scenes.framing: one-point corridor perspective, doors both sides
scenes.information_role: Space loops; time loops with it.

required_assets.description: corridor loop frames + riser + narration s3

scenes.shot_intent: Escalation peak: you have walked this hall before.

scenes.description: REVEAL hero: a single red door breathing (scale pulse) at corridor end, hum visualizer ring. Title: DO NOT MIND THE DOORS.
scenes.information_role: The building is alive; the doors breathe.

required_assets.description: red door frames + impact stinger + narration s4

scenes.shot_intent: Reveal 1: stop pretending it is normal.

scenes.description: Key wall: dozens of tagged keys, one tag sways; empty chairs face the wall. Title: THE HOMES KEEP THEIR PEOPLE.
scenes.framing: wall of keys, chairs in silhouette foreground
scenes.information_role: Handed-over keys never left; residents stayed.
scenes.movement: micro sway on one key + chair flicker

required_assets.description: key-wall frames + low pulse + narration s5

scenes.shot_intent: Reveal 2: the thesis lands like a stamp.

scenes.description: Final tag: black, single fluorescent tube flickers out, CIELO. FOREVER. holds. Letterbox close.
scenes.framing: centered tube on black, tag beneath
scenes.information_role: The day never ends; neither do you.

required_assets.description: tag frames + hum tail + narration s6
